model_annotation: The provided image does not contain Figure 3(a); it displays Figure 4, which is a heatmap illustrating the experimental results of the TextCNN-CB model on the CCKS-IMLTC dataset under different combinations of positive and negative threshold values within the PST framework. The x-axis, labeled “正例阈值 P_th,” represents the positive threshold, ranging from 0.5 to 0.9 with uniform intervals of 0.1. The y-axis, labeled “负例阈值 N_th,” represents the negative threshold, ranging from 0.3 to 0.7 with uniform intervals of 0.1. The heatmap uses a color gradient from light yellow to dark blue, where darker shades indicate higher F1 scores, as shown in the color bar on the right ranging from 72 to 76. Each cell in the grid contains a numerical value representing the F1 score for the corresponding threshold combination; for instance, at P_th=0.6 and N_th=0.4, the F1 score is 75.130, and the highest value in the grid is 75.970 at P_th=0.7 and N_th=0.4. The figure caption and accompanying text note that the optimal performance occurs when the positive threshold is set to 0.6 and the negative threshold to 0.4.
